focus.label: Thapar University campus
focus.note: 2 × 2 km study focus centred on campus; surrounding 3.072 km computational buffer remains visible. GLTF X=east, Z=south.

limits: Mapped individual footprints cover the approximately 2 × 2 km focus and surrounding computational buffer. Four overlapping, ambiguous hostel compound envelopes are excluded in favour of individual outlines; all raw sources remain retained. This is not surveyed completeness.
Overture release 2026-09-23.1 and OSM 2026-10-05. Footprints are source-derived; unknown heights use an explicit 9 m assumption. Buildings have not been added to imitate London density.

Two partial landmark facades use CC BY-SA 2011 photographs. Their exact facade registration and present-day appearance are unverified; other buildings are labelled footprint massing, not full detailed reconstruction.

Pyproj WGS84 azimuthal equidistant about 76.36621 E, 30.35447 N. Flat unsurveyed ground; no measured terrain or tree canopy. Do not overlay the older approximate-projection traffic run without reprojection.

Wind uses the same SCALED surrogate as the original city scenes: 100 transient steps, 4 m geometry, 8 m displayed fields at 8–16 m. Fixed model forcing is not ERA5 wind and not calibrated Patiala weather; 50 s/step is an assumed clock.

Temperature uses the existing three-dimensional physical solver for a controlled 1000 s experiment: 35.4 °C ambient and assumed 40 °C surfaces. It is not a forecast or a measured campus temperature map.
Sunlight uses clear-sky geometry for 21 June and 21 December 2025, with Asia/Kolkata display times. No measured local cloud forcing or evapotranspiration.
No pollution or flood results are asserted for this reconstruction. The older traffic experiment is synthetic passenger-car demand, not observed Indian mixed traffic.
